observations: Frozen spec.json field dynamic_range_certified is false, and its embedded dynamic_range_certificate object has certified=false with cold_max_success_rate=null, retrieval_max_success_rate=null, certified_at_novelty=null.
Frozen prereg.md section 5/12 states that if dynamic_range_certified != true at freeze time the experiment is MEASUREMENT_INVALID and must not proceed to EXECUTE.
The diagnostic re-run of the certificate observed B-COLD-RE-DERIVE success_rate=1.0 and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate=1.0 at novelty 0.5 and 0.75 (both at ceiling; pass=false at both levels).
T-SPIDER-PARAM success_rate was 0.45 overall: 1.0 at novelty 0.0, 0.8 at 0.25, 0.0 at 0.5, 0.0 at 0.75.
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE, B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED and B-EMPTIED-REGISTRY each achieved success_rate=1.0 at all four novelty levels.

cost_per_success was 2.0 composite cost units for every arm whose successes were defined; T-SPIDER-PARAM cost_per_success is undefined (null) at novelty 0.5 and 0.75 because it had zero successes there.
Induced mechanisms for all four resource types carry parameter_supports regexes of the form ^<type>\-00[0-9]{1}$, which match 001-009 only.

The shipped HEAD src/spider/kernel.py (blob cfec9866) lacks distill_parameterized, TrajectoryCounters, _support_accepts and rebind (api_complete=false); the vendored audited blob b15ed848 contains them and was used for the diagnostic run.
Known-negative refusal rate was 1.0 over 20 declared negative task specs on the kernel path; PC-EXACT-REPLAY success_rate was 1.0.
The substrate server handled 316 HTTP request cycles (server_log.jsonl); model_calls and model_tokens were 0 across all arms.
validity_notes: The frozen design already declared the measurement invalid at freeze time: spec.json.dynamic_range_certified=false and the frozen prereg forbids proceeding to EXECUTE. status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID is therefore fixed by the frozen contract, not chosen after seeing outcomes.

The arm success/cost numbers reported here are descriptive diagnostics collected to document the certificate failure and the treatment support boundary. Because the conjunctive primary gate C1 failed before any comparison, C2-C5 were not evaluable and no SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES conclusion may be drawn about C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY.
The token/LLM accounting surface is credential-free by construction (model_calls=0, model_tokens=0); no external model or web access was used.

Representation loss: novelty is operationalized only through contiguous identifier blocks (001-005 vs 006-010 vs 011-015 vs 016-020) and does not vary path/body structure as the prereg's higher novelty levels nominally describe.

The deterministic localhost REST substrate is solved directly by URL construction for every identifier in every block; the comparator arms are therefore structurally at ceiling, which is the same zero-dynamic-range failure mode as parent EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064.

The treatment's observed 0.45 is explained by the induced support regex ^<type>\-00[0-9]{1}$ resolving only 001-009; this is a support-boundary observation, not independent evidence about cost economics.

The shipped kernel regression (blob b15ed848 -> cfec9866 in merge 5601ede3) means the audited treatment carrier is absent from the current shipped path; the diagnostic used a vendored copy of the audited blob, so the run does not certify the shipped path.
No claim state was modified; per frozen prereg section 9, a MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome carries no claim update and requires task-bank redesign and re-freeze.
